name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution. Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v4.9.0: mixed-document calibration release — paragraph-level hi/med/lo thresholds calibrated on the controlled mixed benchmark (333 paragraphs with ground truth; best operating point precision 0.60 at 63% coverage — honestly below the automatic-verdict bar, ranking aid only; references/para_thresholds.json, surfaced in mixed_document assessments); unified entry scripts/pp.py routes all eleven subcommands; batch CSV writes are atomic; gate layers retry once before fallback. v4.8.0: measurement & output-contract integrity (from an independent third-party test round, 13 findings verified and addressed) — run_eval cache keys now bind engine mode (rules-only evaluation no longer replays supervised cached scores; reproducible fingerprint-and-mode-bound: rules 0.8985 old-gen / 0.7149 current-gen on the bundled sample); --profile journal --format json emits pure JSON with a journal_precheck field and both statistics explained; risk_bands (active thresholds + calibration tier) surfaced in every report; mixed_signal denoised (both extremes >=25% of paragraphs); single-file >5MB warning; --batch directory requirement in the error message; honest disclosures for real-world medical FPR and fingerprint attribution limits in the FAQ; corpus scope (n=1,304 bundled vs n=5,251 full) and terminology count (2,308 loaded) corrected. v4.7.0: mixed-document special — controlled mixed-writing benchmark (eval/build_mixed_bench.py: 54 synthesized docs with per-paragraph ground truth from held-out test-half sources only) quantifies paragraph-level AUROC 0.69 vs document-level 0.52-0.54 (fingerprint-bound measurement, eval/results/mixed_para_20261005.json); pp_workflow.py emits a mixed_document assessment (detection, AI-fraction estimate, guidance) and flags mixed documents in the Markdown report; description gained Trigger on routing words; README gained the China mirror (ModelScope) link. Zero new dependencies. v4.6.0: onboarding release — new scripts/pp_workflow.py end-to-end self-check command (AI-rate detection + paragraph attribution + 4-layer gate + terminology + translation-smell + style + quality report + AIGC label check in one pass; Markdown report + full JSON; also pp_api.workflow()) ; TL;DR quick-start layer in both docs; historical release notes moved to CHANGELOG.md; consolidated anti-patterns section; EN FAQ aligned with ZH; superseded eval artifacts archived; SDK/setup errors now carry recovery hints. v4.5.0: programmable-interface release — new scripts/pp_api.py Python SDK (in-process detect_text with CLI parity plus gate_text/term_report/smell_report/style_report/quality_report_file/attribution/model_fingerprint/doctor_summary; zero network, zero third-party deps, JSON dicts, exceptions over silent failures) and scripts/pp_setup.py one-command supervised model installation (--model verifies md5 against the author-signed fingerprint registry references/supervised_models.json, rejects unknown weights, installs, runs an inference canary; --check for status) — closing the two biggest usability friction points reported with the 4.4.x interface (programmatic integration and model setup). v4.4.0: measurement-integrity release — headline numbers re-measured with fingerprint-bound evaluation: pre-2026 held-out AUROC 0.9998 and current-gen AUROC 0.9400 at human FPR@med 2.3%, superseding the 0.9022/0.6542 artifacts (stale score-cache replay + unverified model lineage); run_eval score-cache keys now bind the deployed model md5 (model_fp in result JSONs); new eval/check_leak.py contamination audit halted the v36 supervised retrain (285 fresh samples drawn from the eval set itself: 64.6% of eval docs in training, 154 held-out — numbers void, rollout halted, supervised model stays v35 md5 2631df3d388b); ONNX export gained mandatory variable-length self-tests; PP_ORT_THREADS env caps the ONNX thread pool on many-core hosts; pp_doctor prints the model md5 fingerprint; smoke degradation checks made mode-aware. v4.3.0: generation-split evaluation infrastructure — new 443-doc current-gen eval set (312 fresh AI from 9 families + 131 held-out humans); first quantified generation-gap numbers (pre-2026 corpus AUROC 0.9022 vs current-gen 0.6542); run_eval --layer import fix; spectrum-v2 and L13 current-gen negative results data-closed; supervised retraining on fresh samples planned. v4.2.0: batch recursion (--recursive walks subdirectories, relative paths); GitHub README landing page (description, quick start, family table, compliance statement); gate layer-3 distribution verification on 40 held-out documents (zero parse failures, no systematic shift). v4.1.0: smoothness layer (L13 surprisal-variation) fused into the score at 0.06 weight across all length bands — held-out A/B shows AUROC bit-identical to baseline (0.9022) and human FP unchanged, so the current-generation signal now has real influence at zero measured cost; batch mode gains --csv per-file output; paragraph report carries mixed/register/encoding disclosures consistent with JSON. v4.0.0: paper-workflow family referral loop (SkillHub display-name entries with the arXiv hallucinated-citation policy hook); task-word-root coverage in description (academic writing / polish / batch rewriting guidance / terminology); family-section cleanup (docsor.cn placement, list continuity). First release under the major-version numbering rule. v3.12.0: translation-smell layer revived in deai_gate (schema mismatch fix — the layer had been silently neutral since drift; it now genuinely contributes to the fused score); integrity notice on every report output (term_check/quality_report/style_distance/translation_smell); paragraph-count consistency between quality_report and ai_detector; negative results recorded (spectrum v2 blend no-op on held-out, L13 mid-length declined on data). v3.11.0: batch detection (--batch DIR — per-file scores + aggregate, deterministic, thesis-scale self-review); paragraph_report now carries the academic-integrity notice (consistency); negative result honestly recorded — cross-family tier-2 n-gram mining over 285 fresh samples yields nothing beyond topic noise after guards (pattern-recall via n-grams at ceiling). v3.10.0: fingerprint freshness phase 3 — 135 fresh samples across four current-generation families; kimi-k2.7 registered (zero-FP pattern, Kimi-family attribution verified); topic-word and cross-family contaminated candidates rolled back per quality gate; glm-5.3 refreshed. Registry: 13 families. Sampling+mining via OpenCode Go channel; held-out AUROC unchanged 0.9022. v3.9.0: discourse smoothness disclosure — new surprisal-variation layer (DivEye-inspired windowed-lift CV; held-out AUROC 0.8256 standalone, detection 66/146@6, human FPR 1/14) surfaced as report evidence, NOT fused into the score per the reproducible-numbers iron law; coverage guard 0.35 + evidence discount; run_eval gains --layer mode for reproducible per-layer metric cards. v3.8.0: mixed-register signal (mixed_signal + per-paragraph guidance), register hint, encoding warning, gate layer-divergence disclosure — honest-boundary guardrails aligned with mixed-document and paraphrase-robustness research directions. v3.7.0: discourse-structure heuristic layer (L12, 8 groups, density-scaled cap 30; LES-20260923-021 blind-spot fix; held-out AUROC 0.9022 unchanged); fingerprint freshness 2026-09-23 (kimi-k3 registered via OpenCode Go sampling, attribution-verified; qwen3.8/deepseek-v4 sampled pending quality-pass; registry freshness visible in pp_doctor); centralized FAQ (10 answers), script cheat sheet, clearer edge-case errors, scanner-surface hardening. v3.6.0: academic-integrity guardrails (integrity_notice, Academic Integrity section); CH-side wording cleanup. (Encoding hardening & deai_gate fallback loop shipped in v3.5.0.) v3.5.0: degraded-mode disclosure, iron law #2 (<100 chars -> risk=unknown), pp_doctor self-check, deai_gate fallback loop. v3.4.x: supervised layer + edit-regression v2 (human FPR@p99 0.71%, attack recall 86.6%), language gating. v3.0.0: eval-driven rebuild (AUROC 0.7046->0.9187 held-out).
